propositions: Bare-repository fixtures fail during setup when Git hosts are configured with safe.bareRepository=explicit because commands route through generic cwd= or git -C helpers that trigger implicit repository discovery rejection
Both git config gc.autoDetach false and git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/tickets fail with exit 128 in reclaim/concurrency fixture initialization on hosts with explicit-safe policy
Generic test helpers serve both bare repositories and worktrees, so blanket conversion of all -C invocations to --git-dir is unsafe and would regress worktree semantics

Root cause was identified as commands intentionally owning bare repositories erasing repository-kind intent through implicit discovery; repair must explicitly target only confirmed bare-only call sites while preserving worktree -C behavior
The _verify_restore production function in prepare_reclaim_backup.py contains the same bare-repository initialization pattern and fails identically under strict policy
Repair introduced narrow bare-only Git helpers using top-level --git-dir at each confirmed test and production call site without changing any Git safety settings or repository contracts
